newsitem.title: INDIA: Prosecution of Bihar's Laloo Yadav authorised-PTI.
newsitem.headline: Prosecution of Bihar's Laloo Yadav authorised-PTI.

text.p: Bihar state's governor on Tuesday authorised federal police to prosecute chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav, leader of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's party, in a corruption scandal, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) had sought the governor's permission to prosecute Yadav, president of Gujral's Janata Dal party, in a $280-million "fodder" scandal involving the alleged siphoning off of animal welfare funds.
Yadav has said he is innocent. The Janata Dal is the largest component of the 15-party ruling United Front coalition.
The news agency said governor A.R. Kidwai had also authorised the CBI to prosecute two other Bihar state ministers.
